label: Hook
notes: Cold open on the question. First frame fully composed.

label: Title
notes: Episode title over the first assembled slice of the world.

label: Explain
notes: The workhorse. Nao talks to camera; the board holds a card or live props.

label: Analogy
notes: Physical metaphor. Needs 2+ props and 2+ board items naming the mapping.

label: Diagram
notes: Near-full-frame isometric diagram. Board widens to 940px, presenter narrows.

label: Zoom in
notes: Camera pushes to a named prop and pins a label. Use camera close.

label: Step by step
notes: Numbered steps appear one at a time. 2 to 4 board items.

label: Compare
notes: Two vignettes split by a divider. The left one is the misconception.

label: Packet trip
notes: The camera follows one token along a Paths row. Max one per episode.

label: Myth check
notes: A crossed-out claim, then the correct world rebuilds.

label: Recap
notes: Three or four chips summarise the answer. The world dims behind.

label: Outro
notes: One-line takeaway, episode badge, follow prompt.

label: Wide
notes: 0.80 zoom on the grid centre. Title and recap.

label: Board
notes: 1.00 zoom, board centre. The default.

label: Close
notes: 1.30 zoom on the focused prop. Zoom-in beats.

label: Macro
notes: 1.60 zoom, offset up. Packet trip nodes.

label: Tilt up
notes: 1.00 zoom, panned up 120px. Tall props.

label: Split
notes: 0.90 zoom framed for two vignettes. Compare.

label: Pull back
notes: 0.80 to 1.00 animated across the beat. Outro.

label: Talk hands
notes: Small circular hand movement for the whole beat.

label: Point board
notes: Arm extends toward the board and holds 20 frames.

label: Point camera
notes: One hand toward the viewer. Hook and myth-check.

label: Tap step
notes: A downward tap on the active step chip.

label: Sweep wide
notes: One arm sweeps across the whole board.

label: Count one
notes: Raises one finger. Matches step 1.

label: Count two
notes: Raises two fingers. Matches step 2.

label: Count three
notes: Raises three fingers. Matches step 3.

label: Shrug
notes: Shoulders and palms up, then down.

label: Nod
notes: Head nod, two cycles.

label: Shake no
notes: Head shake, two cycles. Myth check.

label: Lean back
notes: Torso leans away from a bad idea.

label: Settle
notes: Returns to neutral after a gesture.

label: Neutral open
notes: Hands at rest with a slight open. The default.

label: Present open
notes: Both palms up, presenting the board.

label: Point board
notes: One arm to the board, head turned.

label: Point camera
notes: One hand toward the viewer.

label: Think chin
notes: Hand at chin, head tilted.

label: Shrug open
notes: Shoulders up, palms up.

label: Thumbs up
notes: One hand up, confident.

label: Hands on hips
notes: Squared up and emphatic. Compare.

label: Count two
notes: Fingers counting a step.

label: Lean in
notes: Torso forward, conspiratorial. Hook and packet trip.

label: Present wide
notes: Both arms wide, framing the world. Title and diagram.

label: Tired drop
notes: Shoulders down. A comic beat. Use sparingly.

label: Neutral
notes: Default resting face.

label: Curious
notes: One brow up, mouth mid. For a question.

label: Delighted
notes: Squint, blush, smile. A satisfying fact.

label: Surprised
notes: Wide eyes, open mouth. A reveal.

label: Focused
notes: Half eyes, furrowed brows. A mechanism.

label: Skeptical
notes: Half eyes, one brow up, flat mouth. A myth.

label: Confused
notes: Squint, tilted brows. A genuinely hard step.

label: Confident
notes: Open eyes, smile. A conclusion.

label: Sheepish
notes: Looking away, blush. An honest caveat.

label: Emphatic
notes: Open eyes, leaning, open mouth. The key sentence.

label: Relieved
notes: Half eyes, soft smile. After a metaphor lands.

label: Blank
notes: Open eyes, no brows. A deadpan beat.

label: Compute
notes: Blues. Servers, laptops, phones, chips.

label: Network
notes: Greens. Routers, switches, cables, antennas.

label: Storage
notes: Tans. Disks, databases, warehouses, shelves.

label: People
notes: Reds. Hands, envelopes, parcels, figures.

label: Abstract
notes: Violets. Clouds, locks, keys, clocks, tokens.

label: Desktop
notes: A monitor on a plinth with a keyboard. compute.

label: Phone
notes: A slab at an angle, screen face up. compute.

label: Laptop
notes: Open clamshell. compute.

label: Server
notes: A tall rack with three slots. compute.

label: Router
notes: A flat box with two antennae. network.

label: Switch
notes: Wide flat box with port notches. network.

label: Cable
notes: A curved tube between two slots. network.

label: Tower
notes: A lattice mast with a dish. network.

label: Cloud
notes: Three overlapping puffs on a plinth. abstract.

label: Disk
notes: A stack of three platters. storage.

label: Database
notes: A cylinder with banding. storage.

label: Warehouse
notes: A long shed with a roller door. storage.

label: Shelf
notes: Open frame with four rows of boxes. storage.

label: Envelope
notes: A paper slip with a fold. people. Floats.

label: Parcel
notes: A taped box. people.

label: Hand
notes: A stylised flat hand that points. people.

label: Figure
notes: A blocky 2-unit person with no face. people.

label: Queue
notes: Four figures on a rail. people.

label: Lock
notes: A padlock. Shackle open or shut. abstract.

label: Key
notes: A key that floats and rotates. abstract.

label: Clock
notes: A dial with one hand that ticks. abstract.

label: Token
notes: A faceted capsule. This is the travelling packet. abstract.

label: Signpost
notes: A post with one or two arrow signs. abstract.

label: Board
notes: A leaning diagram panel for formulas. abstract.

label: Beginner
notes: 6 to 9s beats, 10 to 14 word captions, 1 to 3 props. Assume zero background.

label: Intermediate
notes: 5 to 7s beats, 12 to 16 word captions, 2 to 4 props. Assume the viewer uses the web daily.

label: Advanced
notes: 4 to 6s beats, 14 to 18 word captions, 3 to 5 props. Assume some technical vocabulary.

label: Networking
notes: DNS, IP, TCP, routing, latency.

label: Security
notes: TLS, passwords, keys, phishing, permissions.

label: Web
notes: Browsers, HTTP, HTML, cookies, rendering.

label: Systems
notes: Operating systems, files, processes, memory.

label: Data
notes: Databases, indexes, caching, compression.

label: Draft
notes: Being written.

label: Scripted
notes: Beats complete and sheet:check passes.

label: Built
notes: episode.json compiled and reviewed.

label: Rendered
notes: final.mp4 exists and verify passes.

label: Published
notes: Posted by hand and publishing.md filled.

label: Fade
notes: 10 frame cross-fade. The default.

label: Wipe
notes: 12 frame vertical card wipe aligned to the iso grid.

label: Cut
notes: Hard cut. Use inside step-by-step and compare.

label: Primary
notes: Spec, RFC, or official documentation. Preferred.

label: Secondary
notes: Explainer, blog, or news. Needs a quote.

label: Definition
notes: A dictionary or standards glossary entry.

label: Measured
notes: Measured by the author. Say how in the quote.
